text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
*Haaah*, *pant*... The pace run... is 
finished...
choice_data_list: Good work. Time for a break.
Good work. Let's take a break.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes...

On this day, as summer camp reached its 
midpoint, Satono Diamond was noticeably 
sluggish in her movements.

Training under the blazing sun is 
physically exhausting. Fatigue from 
consecutive days must be catching up.
Haaaah!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that's ten reps done! I'm starting 
to feel like I've got plenty of stamina to 
spare~.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's double the weight and do 
one more set--!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer, next menu, please!"
choice_data_list: You should rest a little longer...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No, I'm all good! Let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...
choice_data_list:
Let's wrap up this morning's training 
here.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
B-But... the schedule says there's still 
more left...

As she tried to push on with training, I 
explained that running while completely 
exhausted yields little benefit. In fact, 
her lap times had dropped considerably.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
If I stop at my limit... I'll never reach 
what lies beyond! To gain the strength to 
overcome the jinx, I need even more!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Kita-chan is doing her best too! 
I can't afford to lose!

Where she was looking, a short distance 
away, Kitasan Black was sweating profusely 
while powering through one training 
regimen after another.

However, pushing past limits purely 
through grit and fighting spirit like 
Kitasan Black doesn't feel like the right 
fit for Satono Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please make use of this if you'd 
like.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
These are training summaries compiled by 
the instructors who have guided me up 
until now. They include recorded data and 
race footage as well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The Satono family's training environment 
has always incorporated the latest 
equipment. I believe the data is highly 
reliable as well.

She has always trained in well-controlled 
environments. I suspect she has little 
experience training under the blazing sun, 
making her tire out easily in unfamiliar 
conditions.
choice_data_list: Let's pause and have lunch for now.

text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, hey, hey! Satono! And her 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo's gonna train together with you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? Turbo-san?"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Training we can do together! I'm telling 
you, let Satono join in too!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Turbo, please don't rush. Allow me to 
explain first.

While I was standing there dumbfounded, 
the seniors who, as Satono Diamond put it, 
'threw a welcoming party for the 
newcomers,' came filing in one after 
another.

Along with Ikuno Dictus and the others, 
Twin Turbo, Machikane Tannhauser, and 
Daitaku Helios are also here today.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Satono-san, would you care to join us for 
a joint training session?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
One of the perks of the summer camp is 
being able to interact in large groups. 
How about taking this opportunity?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, don't overthink it too much. 
Actually, last year, Teio and the others 
were helping Kitasan out. And then—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No fair, only Teio gets to! Turbo wants to 
be a senior toooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So, if you're up for it, it'd really help 
me out if you joined me.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Come on, please! Hey, Satono! 
Pleeeeeease?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"If you wouldn't mind, would you care to 
join me?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Um... what would you like to do, Trainer?
choice_data_list: What kind of training are you doing?
What kind of training are you going to do?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: These two are the candidates, but—

Ikuno Dictus's proposal makes sense; it's 
a routine that minimizes stamina drain 
while still providing effective training 
without overexertion.

"Above all, it looks fun, and it should 
serve as a good change of pace."
choice_data_list: Could we ask for a joint training session?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yay!! Satono, you can leave everything to 
Senpai Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, then I'll be in your care! 
Turbo-senpai♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's decided, time for lunch~♪ 
Curry, maybe? Or yakisoba? Or maybe go for 
both~?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waaaay☆ Might as well clear the whole 
menu! Everyone's quota is 3 dishes!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait, you guys are fast!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's reconvene here after 
lunch.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now then, which menu item would you 
prefer? What sounds good to you, 
Trainer-san?

The training that suits Satono Diamond 
right now is—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Building a sand tunnel, is it? We have 
permission to use the area near the beach 
hut. Let's head over.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Umm, I have a question. Does making sand 
tunnels really count as training?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It'll be plenty big! We're gonna dig a 
tunnel big enough for us to fit through, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And then, we dig the sand needed for the 
tunnel. Dig, dig, and keep on digging.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I see... That looks like it'll build some 
serious strength!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Phew, will this be enough?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, looks good to me~. Just be careful 
not to fall into any holes you dug!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser-san, you should be careful not 
to fall too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Haua! You're totally right~! ...I'll be 
caaareful...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Umm, next is building the base, right? 
Soak the sand with lots of water, and tamp 
it down firmly.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Pile the sand up to the height of the 
tunnel, stomp on it, pile it, stomp on 
it... Repeat after me♪"

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: The tunnel is complete~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Waaah! We can pass through just fine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: For an amateur job, it's pretty well made!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whew... The exhaustion is really catching 
up to me now...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Digging sand, making countless trips 
fetching seawater, trampling the sand down 
firmly... It really was continuous heavy 
labor, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Still, that was so much fun!

Building sand tunnels not only served as 
effective power training, but also seemed 
to be a nice change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, alright then, last one! I'm gonna 
smash itttt~~!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...What?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I get what you're trying to say. Still, 
we can't just leave a hole dug out like 
that."

The sandcastle was fleeting, turning into 
an illusion. The joint training became a 
bittersweet memory.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Airtime... endurance...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We will use a paper balloon instead 
of a ball. You will understand why once 
you try it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And now, Match 1! Palmer & Helios versus 
Satono & Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy ayyyâ

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Satono, try and keep up with Turbooo!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yeeees♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Here comes the serve~! Take that!

The paper balloon was launched high into 
the sky. ...Yet it showed no sign of 
coming down anytime soon.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right, come on, come on, come on, come 
on! Come on, come on... ARE YOU HERE 
YEEET!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The landing spot is around here... Whoa! 
The wind is...! Please reach...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah... It didn't reach...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Come on, seriously! That balloon is way 
too slow!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Airtime endurance... I see. A paper 
balloon, lighter than a beach ball, stays 
airborne for longer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, since the ball won't reach 
unless you gather enough power before 
striking it back, you have to wait 
patiently while holding your stance, 
correct?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right. You need the composure to wait 
patiently for the right moment and strike 
back with just the right amount of force.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Also, the wind totally blows it away 
sometimes! Running all over the place, 
lolz☆

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Waiting for the right timing... It's just 
like making a move during a race."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It takes endurance not to be swept away by 
others and hold out until your best 
moment. This seems like it will be great 
training!

And—Satono Diamond calmly gauged the wind 
direction and the falling speed of the 
paper balloon, leading her team to 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That was magnificent. Especially you, 
Satono-san. Your unwavering composure 
under any circumstance truly impressed me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, I got totally carried away. It was so 
much fun!

Through joint training, Satono Diamond 
seemed to build her perseverance and 
refresh her mind.
